headline: Reviewed staff reports and announced transition to new accounting firm and software systems
summary: The meeting covered the July 2026 treasurer's report, program and executive director updates, and a plan to move accounting services to Accounting Resources Inc, including new Quickbooks and Bills.com systems and hiring an accounting clerk. The committee also discussed the Uncle Louie Variety Show, Saturday hours, a new Memory Lane Director, and increased local trips for members.
plain_text:
WALLINGFORD COMMITTEE ON AGING, INC. 
September 18 2026 
MINUTES OF MEETING 
 
ATTENDANCE:  Rocco DiGenova, Jane Fisher, Glenn Havumaki, Susan Gomes, Tara Knapp, 
Gus Trujillo, Rosemary DeAngelis, Sean Doherty, Julie Robison, Bob Hughes, Steve Allinson, 
Audrey Grove, Evangeline Bourgeois, Karin Pyskaty and Ann Zak, Erin Ambler 
EXCUSED: Tara Knapp 
ABSENT:  
 
President Jane Fisher called the meeting to order at 9:06 a.m.  
 
SECRETARY’S REPORT 
President Fisher asked if there were any additions or corrections to the July 17, 2026 Secretary’s 
Report.  
Karin Pyskaty made a motion to accept July’s Secretary’s Report. Rosemary DeAngelis 
seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously. 
 
TREASURER’S REPORT 
July 2026  Operating Account Report 
Treasurer Gus Trujillo reported for the new fiscal year July 2026.  
Budget                       $102,604 
Receipts $  99,819.68 
Variance           2,784.82 
Disbursements $  82,424.40 
Variance     20,180.10 
                 Total                          22,964.92 
 
July 2026 Program Account Report 
Trips: Total Commission YTD $22,507  
Fitness Reimbursement    YTD $40,860 
Rosemary DeAngelis made a motion to accept the July Operating Account Report. Glenn 
Havumaki seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously. 
 
CONSENT AGENDA 
President Fisher asked that the Consent Agenda be accepted. 
Karin Pyskaty made a motion to accept the July Consent Agenda. Rosemary DeAngelis  
seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously. 
 
STAFF REPORTS 
Program Director 
Uncle Louie Variety Show October 15. Discussion regarding pricing of entertainment and 
dinner. Successful annual Tag Sale, 40 vendors. Saturday hours show increased attendance. 
Discussion regarding facility maintenance; acknowledgement of Tom’s proactive attention to 
indoor and outdoor facility.
Executive Director 
ED Ann Zak reported: 
 Saturday hours 9:00-1:00. Well attended; continuing to expand programing and volunteer 
opportunities. 
 Welcome Vinny Longobardi as new Memory Lane Director. He will be training and 
working with Deb until the end of the year. 
 Seamless transition to Square credit card system. Ongoing evaluation of additional cost 
of credit card fees. Implemented Zeffy, online donation platform for non-profits. 
 Regarding food and supplies costs, we will continue to monitor and adjust if needed. 
 Replaced the server that ceased to function and would have cost $5,000 to replace with 
cloud-based Microsoft 365 and SharePoint systems recommended by our service 
provider. Monthly cost for licenses is approximately $130/ month, a significant savings. 
 In response to member feedback, we have increased local trips through transportation 
services, including Savin Rock beach and lunch, Peabody Museum, Lunch Bunch, and 
future activities such as hayrides. Low cost and high satisfaction for members. 
 
OLD BUSINESS 
President Fisher circulated the updated Committee Assignments list.  
ED Zak circulated the sign-ups for Celebrate Wallingford. 
 
NEW BUSINESS 
Accounting Services: After considerable review of our critical business office functions and 
overall accounting needs, we will be transitioning to Accounting Resources Inc, a firm 
recommended by our auditor in order to create a stable plan for all aspects of the Senior Center’s 
financial operations, reporting, and data analysis. Data is uploaded to the cloud and automatically 
backed up. Utilizes an upgraded version of Quickbooks that enables access for inputting data and 
analysis in real time. The overall goals are transparency, efficiency, timely data, and accuracy.  
 
As a result, we will be recruiting, hiring, and training an accounting clerk for bank deposits, 
scanning bills, etc. Also, we will transition to Bills.com, which will streamline check cutting, 
signatures, and bill paying.  
 
In addition, ED Zak referenced her reports above.  
 
OTHER BUSINESS 
In response to member inquiries, Tech Connect will continue on-site support pending staffing 
updates. 
 
ADJOURNMENT  
Sean Doherty made the motion to adjourn. Steve Allinson seconded the motion. The 
motion passed unanimously at 10:12. 
 
Next WCOA meeting: October 16, 2026 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
Susan Douglas Gomes, Secretary
